description:
Export a custom CSV report of all products in the 'Clothing' category using the WooCommerce built-in exporter.

1. Navigate to the Products section in the WooCommerce admin panel (already open).
2. Use the 'Export' button to start the export tool.
3. Configure the export settings to include ONLY the following columns:
   - SKU
   - Name
   - Regular price
4. Filter the export to include ONLY products in the 'Clothing' category.
5. Generate the CSV file.
6. Move/Save the resulting file to '/home/ga/Documents/clothing_prices.csv'.

Ensure the file contains only the requested data columns and products.
